canonical.heading: Amazon Quick adds deny by default for custom permissions
canonical.summary: Amazon Quick custom permissions now include deny by default, a governance setting that automatically restricts new AI capabilities before they reach users. Previously, new AI capabilities were available to all users on release, requiring administrators to react after the fact. canonical.heading: Amazon Quick Microsoft 365 extensions are now generally available
canonical.summary: Amazon Quick announces the general availability of Microsoft 365 extensions for Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook. These extensions enable Quick to perform tasks directly within users' M365 environments, using AI to handle complex local tasks such as redlining documents, building financial models, creating presentation-ready decks, and managing Outlook inboxes. canonical.heading: Amazon Quick now supports per-user resource limits
canonical.summary: Amazon Quick now enables administrators to set per-user limits on index storage and agent hours, giving them direct control over subscription costs. With limits management, administrators can create limit profiles that cap per-user consumption, helping prevent unexpected overage charges and ensuring subscription entitlements are used efficiently across their organization. canonical.heading: Amazon Quick now supports data loss prevention with Microsoft Purview
canonical.summary: Amazon Quick now integrates with Microsoft Purview to enforce data loss prevention (DLP) policies across your Quick environment. Organizations need to ensure that sensitive files aren't shared outside approved channels. With this integration, IT administrators and security teams can apply their existing Purview sensitivity labels to automatically control how files are handled in Quick capabilities

canonical.heading: Amazon Quick now supports approval policies for sharing
canonical.summary: Amazon Quick now offers approval policies, giving administrators governance controls over how assets are shared within their organization. canonical.heading: Amazon Quick now supports customizable no data messages for visuals
